newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 659 retail money market mutual funds fell $440.5 million to $597.72 billion in the week ended October 30, the Investment Company Institute, an industry trade group, said Thursday.
It said assets of the 403 taxable money market funds in the retail category rose $8.9 million to $488.54 billion, while assets of the 256 tax-exempt funds fell $449.5 million to $109.17 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 311 institutional money market funds rose $1.20 billion to $280.77 billion. Of these, the 247 taxable money market fund assets grew $1.53 billion to $252.23 billion, and assets of the 64 tax exempt funds fell $328.8 million to $28.54 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $878.48 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended October 23 were revised to $877.72 billion from $877.39 billion.
